field_updates.detail: "Reverse recovery time IF = IR = 10 mA, iR = 1 mA ... 8" ns max; "IF = 10 mA, VR = 6 V, iR = 0.1 x IR, RL = 100 ohm ... 4" ns max Method: Charge-control storage-time estimate used by the SPICE lumped-charge diode: ts = TT*ln(1+IF/IR). Treating the whole quoted trr as storage time gives TT = trr/ln(1+IF/IR). Ignores the recovery tail to the quoted Irr, junction capacitance and RS, so it over-estimates TT. TT <= 8 ns/ln 2 = 11.5 ns; upper bound from a max trr, not typical. Class default 23 ns exceeds it.

remaining_open_items: The BZV55 Zener alternative needs its own voltage row and model; this source only establishes the LL4148 switching variant.
Fitted nominal diode parameters and mounting-dependent heating remain approximate.
